title: Coast Guard rescues 4 boaters 2 miles east of Pritchards Island
description: A Coast Guard Air Facility Charleston MH-65 Dolphin helicopter crew rescues four boaters Wednesday, May 24, 2017, after their vessel, the 80-foot fishing vessel Gracie Bell, became disabled two miles east of Pritchards Island, South Carolina. U.S. Coast Guard video courtesy of Air Station Savannah.
